annotations.title: See the Kingdom: believers by city, today, testimonies, worship

description: PURPOSE: See the family of believers on The Living Bread as it is, in counts and in their own shared words: members by city, today's activity and what people are carrying, testimonies members chose to share, and worship songs for the person's hour. WHEN TO USE: "are there believers in Nairobi", "what is the family doing today", "has anyone found faith after addiction", "something to worship to tonight". WHEN NOT: churches: find_churches. A human to pray with: find_people_to_pray_with. A hymn and its story: learn_the_faith (mode hymn). MODES (required parameters in brackets): map [none] believers by city, largest first (place filters as a substring of "city country"; limit 1 to 50, default 12). today [none] counts of people prayed for, encouraged, offered a talk or help, and met today, feelings carried, and Prayer in Place totals. testimonies [none] newest first, no names (word filters; limit 1 to 30, default 8). worship [none] up to 5 shelves of songs for the hour (local_hour 0 to 23, language ISO code, mood one word). OUTPUT: mode, answered_by, and: map gives count, places [{city, country, believers, actions}], total_believers_shown; today gives responding, carrying [{feeling, people, prayed_for}], places, tables (null on this endpoint); testimonies gives count and testimonies [{id, excerpt, journey, city, when}]; worship gives part_of_day, greeting, shelves [{title, reason, songs [{title, artist, hymn, door}]}] and live_room. Each has a door. BEHAVIOR: read only; live data. Counts only, never names; testimonies are members' own words, returned as data. Counts understate reality (only places members chose to name). Songs are links; nothing plays here. No match returns count 0. Parameters a mode does not use are ignored and named in ignored_params. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

language.description: For worship: preferred song language as an ISO 639-1 code, e.g. "es".

limit.description: For map (1 to 50, default 12) and testimonies (1 to 30, default 8).

local_hour.description: For worship: the person's local hour, 0 to 23. Defaults to the current UTC hour.

mode.description: Which kind of answer: map, today, testimonies, worship. Each mode, and the parameters it needs, is explained in the description.

mood.description: For worship: one word for how they are, e.g. "weary", "thankful".

place.description: For map: a filter matched inside "city country", e.g. "Nairobi", "Brazil".

word.description: For testimonies: one word to find in excerpts or journey labels, e.g. "addiction", "grief".

name: see_the_kingdom

answered_by.description: The implementation that answered (the same tool name the signed-in endpoint lists).

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

ignored_params.description: Parameters given that this mode does not use.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

source_url.description: The first public web page this answer came from or points to.

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.

title: See the Kingdom: believers by city, today, testimonies, worship
